arxiv-1710-06413.title: Discrete Dark Matter Model And Reactor Mixing Angle
arxiv-1710-06413.creator: J. M. Lamprea
arxiv-1710-06413.description: Abstract We present a scenario where the stability of dark matter and the phenomenology of neutrinos are related by the breaking of a flavour symmetry. We propose two models based on this idea for which we have obtained interesting neutrino and dark matter phenomenology.

arxiv-2204-13636.title: Note on T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} deformed matrix models and JT supergravity duals
arxiv-2204-13636.creator: Song He 1,2, Hao Ouyang 1, Yuan Sun 1
arxiv-2204-13636.description: Abstract In this work we calculate the partition functions of 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 type 0A and 0B JT supergravity (SJT) on 2D surfaces of arbitrary genus with multiple finite cut-off boundaries, based on the T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} deformed super-Schwarzian theories.

arxiv-2205-04163.title: Homological Shifts of Polymatroidal ideals Thanks: .
arxiv-2205-04163.creator: Antonino Ficarra
arxiv-2205-04163.description: Abstract . We study the homological shifts of polymatroidal ideals. In our main theorem we prove that the first homological shift ideal of any polymatroidal ideal is again polymatroidal, supporting a conjecture of Bandari, Bayati and Herzog that predicts that all homological shift ideals of a polymatroidal ideal are polymatroidal.

arxiv-2208-06869.title: Generalized Ellis-Bronnikov graphene wormhole
arxiv-2208-06869.creator: T. F. de Souza, A. C. A. Ramos, R. N. Costa Filho, J. Furtado
arxiv-2208-06869.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the spinless stationary Schrödinger equation for the electron when it is permanently bound to a generalized Ellis-Bronnikov graphene wormhole-like surface. The curvature gives rise to a geometric potential affecting thus the electronic dynamics. The geometry of the wormhole’s shape is controlled by the parameter n n which assumes even values.

arxiv-2302-12988.title: The Isotope Effect and Critical Magnetic Fields of Superconducting YH 6 : A Migdal-Eliashberg Theory Approach
arxiv-2302-12988.creator: S. Villa-Cortés, O. De la Peña-Seaman, Keith V. Lawler, Ashkan Salamat
arxiv-2302-12988.description: Abstract The emergence of near-ambient temperature superconductivity under pressure in the metal hydride systems has motivated a desire to further understand such remarkable properties, specifically critical magnetic fields. YH 6 is suggested to be a departure from conventional superconductivity, due to apparent anomalous behavior.

arxiv-2307-01206.title: Confidence Ranking for CTR Prediction CCS: Information systems Retrieval models and ranking CCS: Information systems Online advertising CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2307-01206.creator: Jian Zhu, Congcong Liu, Pei Wang, Xiwei Zhao, Zhangang Lin, Jingping Shao
arxiv-2307-01206.description: Abstract . Model evolution and constant availability of data are two common phenomenon in large-scale real-world machine learning application, e.g. ads and recommendation system. To adapt, real-world system typically retrain with all available data and online learn with recent available data to update the models periodically with the goal of better serving performance.

arxiv-2308-14980.title: Scope and limitations of ad hoc neural network reconstructions of solar wind parameters
arxiv-2308-14980.creator: Maximilian Hecht, Verena Heidrich-Meisner, Lars Berger, and Robert F. Wimmer-Schweingruber
arxiv-2308-14980.description: Abstract Context. Solar wind properties are determined by the conditions of their solar source region and transport history. Solar wind parameters, such as proton speed, proton density, proton temperature, magnetic field strength, and the charge state composition of oxygen, are used as proxies to investigate the solar source region of the solar wind.

arxiv-2311-15794.title: A note on new weighted geometric inequalities for hypersurfaces in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n}
arxiv-2311-15794.creator: Jie Wu
arxiv-2311-15794.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jie Wu. In this note, we prove a family of sharp weighed inequality which involves weighted k k -th mean curvature integral and two distinct quermassintegrals for closed hypersurfaces in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} . This inequality generalizes the corresponding result of Wei and Zhou [ 15 ] where their proof is based on earlier results of Kwong-Miao [ 10 , 11 ] . Here we present a proof which does not rely on Kwong-Miao’s results. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification
53A07, 53C44.

arxiv-2412-14555.title: Single-Loop Federated Actor-Critic across Heterogeneous Environments
arxiv-2412-14555.creator: Ye Zhu, Xiaowen Gong
arxiv-2412-14555.description: Abstract Federated reinforcement learning (FRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm, enabling multiple agents to collaborate and learn a shared policy adaptable across heterogeneous environments. Among the various reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, the actor-critic (AC) algorithm stands out for its low variance and high sample efficiency.

arxiv-2503-18655.title: Entropy-assisted, long-period stacking of honeycomb layers in an AlB 2 -type silicide
arxiv-2503-18655.creator: Leonie Spitz 1,2, Takuya Nomoto 3, Shunsuke Kitou 1, Hironori Nakao 4, Akiko Kikkawa 1, Sonia Francoual 5, Yasujiro Taguchi 1, Ryotaro Arita 1,3, Yoshinori Tokura 1,3,6, Taka-hisa Arima 1,7, Max Hirschberger 1,3
arxiv-2503-18655.description: Abstract Abstract Configurational entropy can impact crystallization processes, tipping the scales between structures of nearly equal internal energy. Using alloyed single crystals of Gd 2 PdSi 3 in the AlB 2 -type structure, we explore the formation of complex layer sequences made from alternating, two-dimensional triangular and honeycomb slabs.

arxiv-2507-05341.title: Topological phase diagram of twisted bilayer graphene as a function of the twist angle
arxiv-2507-05341.creator: Leonardo A. Navarro-Labastida, Pierre A. Pantaleón, Francisco Guinea, Gerardo G. Naumis
arxiv-2507-05341.description: Abstract Twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) hosts a rich landscape of electronic phases arising from the interplay between strong electron-electron interactions and nontrivial band topology. While the flat bands near zero energy are central to many correlated phenomena, their interaction with higher-energy remote bands remains less understood.

arxiv-2511-10593.title: Regular Games – an Automata-Based General Game Playing Language
arxiv-2511-10593.creator: Radosław Miernik, Marek Szykuła Jakub Kowalski
arxiv-2511-10593.description: Abstract We propose a new General Game Playing (GGP) system called Regular Games (RG). The main goal of RG is to be both computationally efficient and convenient for game design. The system consists of several languages. The core component is a low-level language that defines the rules by a finite automaton.

arxiv-2512-06359.title: A Low-rank Augmented Lagrangian Method for Polyhedral–SDP and Moment-SOS Relaxations of Polynomial Optimization
arxiv-2512-06359.creator: Di Hou, Tianyun Tang, Kim-Chuan Toh
arxiv-2512-06359.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Di Hou, Tianyun Tang, Kim-Chuan Toh. Polynomial optimization problems (POPs) can be reformulated as geometric convex conic programs, as shown by Kim, Kojima, and Toh (SIOPT 30:1251–1273, 2020), though such formulations remain NP-hard. In this work, we prove that several well-known relaxations can be unified under a common polyhedral–SDP framework, which arises by approximating the intractable cone by tractable intersections of polyhedral cones with the positive semidefinite matrix cone.

pmc-10596025.creator: K Schultz Petersen, C H Hansen, K Fonager, H Bøggild
pmc-10596025.description: BackgroundTrends towards longer labor market participation are seen in international policies. In the EU countries, labor force participation rate for those past 60 years of age, has been raised extensively for the past decade. In 2035 Danish workers are expected to work till 69 years of age.

pmc-10834750.title: Genome-wide identification of TPS and TPP genes in cultivated peanut (Arachis hypogaea) and functional characterization of AhTPS9 in response to cold stress
pmc-10834750.creator: Chao Zhong, Zehua He, Yu Liu, Zhao Li, Xiaoguang Wang, Chunji Jiang, Shuli Kang, Xibo Liu, Shuli Zhao, Jing Wang, He Zhang, Xinhua Zhao, Haiqiu Yu
pmc-10834750.description: IntroductionTrehalose is vital for plant metabolism, growth, and stress resilience, relying on Trehalose-6-phosphate synthase (TPS) and Trehalose-6-phosphate phosphatase (TPP) genes. Research on these genes in cultivated peanuts (Arachis hypogaea) is limited.MethodsThis study employed bioinformatics to identify and analyze AhTPS and AhTPP genes in cultivated peanuts, with subsequent experimental validation of AhTPS9’s role in cold tolerance.

pmc-12730111.title: A Reproducible Sequence-Level Strategy to Enhance Peptide Immunogenicity While Preserving Wild-Type Epitope Recognition
pmc-12730111.creator: Chia-Hung Chen, Yu-Chi Chiu, Kai-Yao Huang, Hsiao-Hsuan Huang, Ta-Wei Kuo, Yu-Chi Liu, Hui-Ju Kao, Chen-Lin Yu, Shun-Long Weng, Kuang-Wen Liao, Adam Barb
pmc-12730111.description: Background: Short peptide epitopes are valuable for mechanistic studies, yet their intrinsic low immunogenicity and lack of commercial antibodies hinder rapid antibody generation. Methods: We developed a reproducible, sequence-level workflow combining cross-species/structural triage, independent MHC-I/II prioritization, and conservative heteroclitic-style substitutions to enhance predicted MHC affinity while preserving native epitope features.

pmc-13199993.title: Prevalence and Its Associated Factors of Anemia Among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care in Health Institutions of Hargeisa, Somaliland
pmc-13199993.creator: Naima Abdikarim, Haftu Asmerom, Zerihun Ataro, Ephrem Tefera Solomon
pmc-13199993.description: BackgroundAnemia is one of the most common worldwide public health problems related to pregnancy. However, there is a scarcity of evidence regarding anemia among pregnant women in Somaliland, particularly in Hargeisa city. Therefore, this study aimed to assess the prevalence and its associated factors of anemia among pregnant women attending antenatal care in health institutions of Hargeisa, Somaliland.
